---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new idea, archetype, motion recipe, or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "awaiting triage"]
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A concise description of the friction or limitation (e.g., "I wish master-implementer supported 3D interactive splines...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear description of what you want to happen and how the skill or prompt should behave.

**Component or Motion Archetype Details**
If this introduces a new UI or animation pattern, provide:
- Visual reference link or inspiration URL
- Key CSS/motion properties or layout math
- Category applicability (e.g., Luxury, FinTech, Agency)

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or code examples here.
